spoken_text: Sam, here's the bottom line. The new ads are healthy and running under budget. Over the last seven days we spent about a hundred seventy three dollars against a two hundred ten dollar cap, up from about a hundred seventeen the week before. Today ran hot at thirty nine dollars against a thirty dollar target, but that's Google's normal daily smoothing, not a runaway. We got two leads today and both are verified paid, one of them in our own lane. My read is the spend is disciplined and attribution is finally working. I recommend we restore search term reporting so we can build a proper negatives list, and hold budgets where they are. One caveat: this report came in without the structured data file, so the instant answer cache is still showing yesterday's numbers.
